name: Kurayami no Hate de Kimi o Matsu
original_name: 暗闇の果てで君を待つ
source:
During the middle of an outdoor hiking event at your school you suddenly get sick. 
It was decided that you should go back to camp by bus along with the student council president Aoi Mio, your childhood friend Sakuraba Katsumi, members of the tennis club Honami Yousuke and Akiyama Tomo, a student from another school Kazano Tarou, your teacher Kousaka Takahiko, and the trainee teacher Mikomoto Naoki.

However along the way you met with an accident.
When you came to, you and everyone else on the bus were trapped in an unknown abandoned school.

There you found a letter from a person calling themself "Death Mask". It read "If you do not escape from this school according to my orders you will meet with death."

[Translated from the [url=http://www.d3p.co.jp/kurakimi/]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
學校舉行戶外健行期間，你突然感到身體不適。
大家決定讓你與學生會長葵水央、青梅竹馬櫻葉克己、網球社的穗波陽介與秋山朋、來自其他學校的風野太郎、教師高坂貴彥，以及實習教師御子元直樹一起搭巴士回營地。

然而途中發生了事故。
恢復意識後，你發現自己與車上所有人都被困在一所陌生的廢棄學校裡。

眾人還發現了一封自稱「死亡面具」之人留下的信，上面寫著：「如果不按照我的命令逃出學校，你們就會面對死亡。」

[翻譯自[url=http://www.d3p.co.jp/kurakimi/]官方網站[/url]]
